The official codebase of paper "GMT: General Motion Tracking for Humanoid Whole-Body Control"

General Motion Tracking for Humanoid Whole-Body Control Zixuan Chen *,1,2 | Mazeyu Ji *,1 | Xuxin Cheng 1 | Xuanbin Peng 1 Xue Bin Peng† 2 | Xiaolong Wang† 1 1 UC San Diego &nbsp 2 Simon Fraser University * Equal Contribution &nbsp † Equal Advising Website | arXiv | Video ## Overview This codebase supports Mujoco simulation of motion tracking on Unitree G1 robot. We provide a pretrained checkpoint and several example motions. This codebase is lightweight and easy to use. We have tested it both on Linux and M1 MacOS. ## Installation && Running First, clone this repo and install all the dependencies: Then you can start to test the pretrained policy's performance on several example motions by running the following command: To change motions, you can replace `walk_stand.pkl` with other motions in the [motions](assets/motions/) folder. The model we provide is for research use only, and we disclaim all responsibility for any harm, loss, or malfunction arising from its deployment. ## News - [ ] Data processing and retargeter code will be released soon. ## Acknowledgements + The Mujoco simulation script is originally adapted from [LCP](https://github.com/zixuan417/smooth-humanoid-locomotion). + For human motion part, we mainly refer to [ASE](https://github.com/nv-tlabs/ASE) and [PHC](https://github.com/ZhengyiLuo/PHC). ## Citation If you find this codebase useful, please consider citing our work:
abstract_zh: 本文提出了GMT（通用运动跟踪）方法，用于人形机器人的全身控制。该代码库支持在Unitree G1机器人上进行Mujoco仿真运动跟踪，提供了预训练模型和多种示例运动。代码库轻量且易于使用，已在Linux和M1 MacOS上测试通过。用户可通过简单命令测试策略性能，并切换不同运动。注意：策略在不同机器人上性能可能有所差异，仅供研究使用。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：基于强化学习训练全身控制策略，在Mujoco仿真环境中对Unitree G1进行运动跟踪，支持替换不同动作并查看运动学结果，同时提供预训练模型直接测试。


# 一、动机

> 人形机器人全身运动跟踪缺乏轻量易用的开源实现，现有系统往往复杂且难以复现，本工作旨在提供一个简洁的代码库以支持Unitree G1上的运动跟踪研究。


# 二、方法

> 基于强化学习训练全身控制策略，在Mujoco仿真环境中对Unitree G1进行运动跟踪，支持替换不同动作并查看运动学结果，同时提供预训练模型直接测试。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 预训练策略在多种示例动作（如walk_stand）上测试成功，但未给出具体量化指标（如跟踪误差或成功率）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与课题不直接相关（课题偏向机器人操作，而本文侧重运动跟踪），但其轻量仿真框架和预训练模型可复用于全身控制研究，且数据与重定向代码尚未发布，存在一定局限性。
